note: Atlassian's published token surface, MEASURED rather than remembered. Not derived from anything in this repository. Re-measure with `npm run benchmark:atlassian -- --how` and record the date; check:atlassian-benchmark holds our own numbers to the directions below.
method: Read the rendered page and matched every line of the form `<group>.<path>` against /^(color|elevation|space|font|border|opacity|shadow|utility|layer)\.[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+$/m, de-duplicated, then grouped by the first and second segments. Counts are of DISTINCT token names on that page.

typeSteps.note: Each of these is ONE token carrying size, line-height and weight together. There is no separate `font.lineHeight.*` namespace on the page at all — the 23 `font.*` tokens are these 14 steps plus 4 weights and 5 families.

ours.note: OUR side of the comparison, recorded 2026-08-29 so the enforced rows have a starting point. Each row moves in one direction only — see ROWS in scripts/atlassian-benchmark.mjs, where the direction is argued. Re-record with `npm run benchmark:atlassian -- --update` AFTER the move, never to get past a red run.
